scope: Theorem 1.1 (Binary sweep contraction) of the manuscript “Conditional coordinate sweeps and analytic transfer” (preprints/Conditional-coordinate-sweeps-and-analytic-transfer-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 50b927834abd484c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants g > 0 and d0 such that, for d ≥ d0 and every λ ⊢ 2d, ∥Kλ∥op ≤ D−g λ . The sign representation is annihilated. There is an absolute positive integer w such that the law after w independent sweeps converges to uniform in total variation as d → ∞, uniformly over deterministic initial decks.
